evidence.description: handleStructuredAuthRequest session endpoint now returns 401 for absent cookie (line 330), not-found record (line 338), and failed validation (line 343). Returns 200 {linked: true} only for valid sessions. FIND-101 resolved.

handleStructuredAuthRequest callback implements full REQ-AUTH-002 flow: param validation, atomic state consumption, Discord exchange, link session issuance, Set-Cookie, 302 redirect with security headers.
PROP-AUTH-018 verifies __Host-link_session Set-Cookie attributes through structured callback flow.
57 Tier 1 tests covering all 15 pure core PROPs (PROP-AUTH-001 through PROP-AUTH-034). All REQ-AUTH requirements have corresponding tests.
PROP-AUTH-004: isExpired boundary tests cover before/after/exact boundary cases.
PROP-AUTH-008: isSameOrigin covers scheme mismatch, host mismatch, port mismatch, null origin, case-insensitive host, trailing slash, default port normalization.
PROP-AUTH-011: All four callback 401 failure modes tested via consumeOAuthState integration.
Mixed-case sensitive key masking tested (Cookie, AUTHORIZATION, Set-Cookie).
Pure core has no node:crypto import. Hash functions are in shell/index.ts.
Config interface now includes discordClientSecret. FIND-105 resolved.
exchangeDiscordCode receives clientSecret from config: clientSecret: discordClientSecret.
validateOAuthStateRecord checks all four conditions in correct order: state hash match, session hash match, not expired, not used.
isSameOrigin implements RFC 6454 correctly: null rejection, trailing slash rejection, case-insensitive hostname, default port normalization.
handleStructuredAuthRequest uses config parameters for all endpoints; no hardcoded values in the structured path.
Pure core contains 16 deterministic functions with no I/O imports. Purity boundary is clean.
In-memory store is isolated with clear API (get/set/clear/counts). No coupling leaks.
Shared types are well-defined with domain?: never enforcing absent Domain in CookieAttributes.
Traceability matrix covers all 15 REQ + 4 NFR with PROP mappings. PROP numbering is non-contiguous (001-009, 027-028, 031-036) but all IDs are traceable to requirements.
PROP coverage table: 15 Tier 1 + 18 Tier 2 + 3 Tier 3 (deferred) = 36 PROPs. All Tier 1 and Tier 2 PROPs have status 'tested'.
Hash functions (stateHash, oauthSessionHash, linkSessionTokenHash) and handleAuthRequest correctly listed in effectful shell table.

summary: PASS: 0 critical, 0 major, 3 minor findings. Within the contract pass threshold (0 critical, at most 2 major). The critical iter2 FIND-101 (session endpoint returning 200 instead of 401 for invalid conditions) is RESOLVED: handleStructuredAuthRequest now returns 401 for absent cookie, not-found record, and failed validation per REQ-AUTH-004 edge cases. FIND-105 (missing discordClientSecret in config type) is RESOLVED: config interface and call site both include discordClientSecret. Three minor findings persist as structural debt: FIND-202 (legacy handler hardcoded values from iter1 FIND-006), FIND-203 (PROP-AUTH-012 tautological legacy test from iter2 FIND-103), FIND-201 (PROP-AUTH-022 tests pure function directly instead of through session endpoint integration path). These are test quality issues in secondary code paths; the primary structured handler path is correctly implemented and tested. Of 19 total prior findings across iter1 and iter2, 16 are fully resolved, 3 minor findings persist as carry-overs with new IDs.
